top_story: Trump’s 23 March threat to destroy Iran’s power plants unless Tehran reopens the Strait of Hormuz pushed Iranian officials and military figures to warn of wider regional escalation, sharpening the risk that pressure on Iran’s infrastructure could spill into Gulf security and shipping lanes.
